title: Undo a restore does not stick for a member signed in to MettleUp: the backup's workouts come back seconds later
what: About 8 seconds after a restore, the background copy sends the restored workouts to the member's MettleUp account. If the member then taps Undo (offered on the screen and for 24 hours in Settings), the phone is put back, but the undo also forgets what was copied and asks for a bring-back first. The bring-back finds the restored workouts on the server, sees the phone lacks them, and writes them back onto the phone. The member is told the phone is back to how it was, yet the restored workouts reappear.
expected: After Undo, the restored workouts are gone from the phone and from the saved copy on MettleUp, and stay gone.
who: members signed in to a MettleUp account who restore a backup file and then undo it
how_often: every undo made more than about 8 seconds after the restore while online
fix_line: Pause the background copy while an undo is possible, or have Undo send deletes for the restored workouts instead of asking for a bring-back

title: Replace everything on this phone brings the old workouts straight back for a signed-in member
what: The restore screen says this phone's workouts, routines and measurements go and the backup's come in. For a member signed in to MettleUp, the restore then asks for a bring-back of the saved copy, and every workout, routine and body weight the saved copy holds that the backup lacks is put back on the phone within seconds. The member ends with both sets, not the backup alone, and is not told.
expected: The words before Replace say that, while signed in, the workouts saved on MettleUp come back too; or Replace really replaces the saved copy as well, after asking.
who: members signed in to a MettleUp account who restore a backup with Replace
how_often: every Replace restore while signed in
fix_line: Tell the member before Replace that their saved workouts on MettleUp come back, or offer to replace those too

title: Bring back my workouts can give a wrong count
what: The count after Bring back my workouts also counts workouts the phone already had under another id (they only swap to the server's id) and workouts only updated from another phone. When no workout came back but routines or body weights did, it says everything was already on this phone.
expected: The count names only workouts that were not on the phone before, and the line mentions routines and body weights that came back.
who: members who bring back their workouts
how_often: when the phone already held some of the same workouts
fix_line: Count only new workouts and mention other things that came back

title: Signing in on a new phone loses hidden exercises and changes made to how a library exercise is logged
what: The account card promises that on a new phone everything comes back. The saved copy on MettleUp keeps only the member's own exercises, not the library exercises they hid nor the changes they made to how a library exercise is logged or how its weight counts. The Download my data file does keep both. On a new phone, hidden exercises show again and a changed library exercise goes back to its default way of logging.
expected: The saved copy carries the same hidden exercises and library changes as the backup file, so a new phone shows the exercise list as the member left it.
who: members who move to a new phone by signing in
how_often: every new phone set up from the account, for members who hid or changed a library exercise
fix_line: Add the hidden list and library changes to the saved copy as one more item

title: If the coach comes back, a made-up number in its reply reaches the member unchecked
what: The coach is told never to invent stored numbers. The check that spots a number in the reply that came from no stored data runs only in test builds and only writes a note; members' builds never check. Switched off today.
expected: Before the coach is switched on, a reply with a number not found in the member's data is flagged or held in members' builds too.
who: members, if the coach is switched on
fix_line: Run the number check in every build and act on it before the coach returns
